data.summary: red-b held tests/test_no_agent_literals.py; red-h queued for it (lease.waiting). red-b's `update --globs`, adding only an unrelated free file (docs/ddflow/research/driver-inventory.md) and keeping the held list, was refused 'those globs are queued behind red-h, who asked for them first', and recorded red-b as waiting on red-h: `ddflow lanes` then shows a two-lane cycle though red-h holds nothing red-b needs. A glob the requester already holds should not queue behind a waiter for it, and the refusal should name the one contended glob instead of 'those globs'.
data.title: Widening an item is refused over a glob it already holds when another lane queued for it, creating a wait cycle
